subject: fitting specific spatio-temporal model using INLA

messages.author: 8da4d3723e3a60d9
messages.subject: fitting specific spatio-temporal model using INLA
parts:
Hello

I want to fit spatio-temporal model based on following equation:
y=xB+e A+ epsilon
where dimension as follow:
y:T*N
x: T*K
B:K*N
e: T*r
A:r*N
epsilon:T*N
s.t: N:number of spatial points   T:time points   r: autoregressive coefficient (here consider r=1)
I want to use below prior for parameters:
rw1 for B.
rw1 for A.
ar1 for A.
In other words, i have two spatial prior one for B and one for A and also temporal prior(ar1) for A.
Finally, i need to map posterior mean for every column of matrix x.

I write this model using INLA: (for e.g. k=2)

formula <- y~

x1+x2+  #each column of x

f(ID.spatial,model="rw1",graph=?) + #spatial prior for B

f(ID.time1,model="ar1") +  # temporal modeling of A (AR(1))

f(ID.time2,model="iid")+  # Unstructrued noise

f(ID.time3,model="rw1",graph=?) # spatial prior for A


Finally, i need mapping posterior mean for x1 and x2 based on spatial points(in above equation N is number of spatial points).
I have two problem about this:
1) How do i define neighboring graph for spatial section? (about this, note i have just coordinates of points and i read section 6.1 from "Spatial and spatio-temporal Bayesian models with R-INLA" but unfortunately i couldn't solve my problem)
2) How do i map posterior mean for x1 and x2?

Could any one please guide me about these?
Thank you.
